grid.name: Residential (cold)
grid.description: Single-family home in Minneapolis MN, flat tariff with a low export credit: value comes from PV self-consumption.
grid.strategy: The price is flat, so arbitrage is worthless. The only value is storing solar that would otherwise be exported at 25% of retail and using it in the evening.

blurbs.LP: Linear program with perfect foresight of the actual day. Its objective is exactly the environment's daily cost, so it is the true optimum.
blurbs.MPC: Model-predictive control: re-solves the LP every hour on the forecast and applies the first action. This is the closed-loop baseline a utility would deploy.
blurbs.SAC: Soft Actor-Critic specialist trained on this grid only: GPU-batched env, 6M steps, with the best checkpoint picked on validation days.
blurbs.Generalist SAC: One SAC policy trained on all six grids at once. It reads a 9-feature grid descriptor to know which grid it is controlling.
blurbs.R-SAC: SAC trained under domain randomisation: each episode draws forecast error up to 30%.
blurbs.PPO: Proximal Policy Optimisation specialist with a tanh-squashed Gaussian, trained on 512 parallel envs for 10M steps.
blurbs.Zero-shot SAC: SAC trained on the other five grids and never shown this one (leave-one-grid-out transfer test).
Self-consumption heuristic: charge on surplus PV, discharge to cover load, and steer back to 50% SOC over the last four hours.
blurbs.Rule-Based: The original price-threshold heuristic from the single-home study.
blurbs.NoOp: Battery idle for all 24 hours. This is the reference for savings.
